d: Yemen’s Houthis say they attacked Saudi Arabia’s Ras Tanura oil refinery and Riyadh’s financial district. Houthi military spokesperson Yahya Saree said the refinery attack caused fires and that the financial district was targeted in three phases. Saudi air defences intercepted and destroyed four drones over Ras Tanura in the kingdom’s Eastern Province. Ras Tanura is Saudi Arabia’s largest refinery and part of a major crude export complex on the Gulf coast.
